title: psycopg2.errors.DatatypeMismatch when using array of enum and with_variant

labels.name: datatypes
labels.description: things to do with database types, like VARCHAR and others

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
**Describe the bug**
Using a type `ARRAY(Enum(enum_class)).with_variant(...)` on PostgreSQL, when inserting values, the array is not cast as it is without the `with_variant(...)`, resulting in the following error: 

```
sqlalchemy.exc.ProgrammingError: (psycopg2.errors.DatatypeMismatch) column "items" is of type myenum[] but expression is of type text[]
```

It won't check the existance of the type either.

This issue is only present in SQLAlchemy > 1.3.23

**Expected behavior**
Emitted queries should be the same as the one without `with_variant`
 
**To Reproduce**

Note that in this example the `with_variant` doesn't make any sens at all, but that was to simplify the example. Same issue is observed no matter what we have in the `with_variant` arguments.

```py
import enum

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, Enum, ARRAY
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker


engine = create_engine("postgresql://user@host/db", echo=True)
Base = declarative_base()
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)


class MyEnum(enum.Enum):
    a = "a"
    b = "b"


# Variant type doesn't seems to matter at all, anything else with trigger the same issue
TypeWithVariant = ARRAY(Enum(MyEnum)).with_variant(ARRAY(Enum(MyEnum)), "other")


class MyModel(Base):
    __tablename__ = "my_model"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    items = Column(TypeWithVariant)


Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

session = Session()
obj = MyModel(items=[MyEnum.a])

session.add(obj)
session.commit()

```
**Emitted query:**

```sql
INSERT INTO my_model (items) VALUES (%(items)s) RETURNING my_model.id
```

**Emitted query without the `with_variant()` call**

```sql
INSERT INTO my_model (items) VALUES (%(items)s::myenum[]) RETURNING my_model.id
```

**Versions.**
 - OS: any
 - Python: 3.9
 - SQLAlchemy: >1.3.23
 - Database: postgresql
 - DBAPI: psycopg2 2.8.6

**Additional context**
I've tried to play with the arguments of `with_variant`, testing multiple types, but it always result in the same error.
